description: Source file defining enums and a class for managing voice wake chimes, including playing sounds, cataloging options, and handling different chime types.

classes.name: VoiceWakeChime
classes.description: An enum representing different chime options for voice wake, including none, system sounds, and custom sounds with display names and bookmarks.

classes.name: VoiceWakeChimeCatalog
classes.description: A utility struct providing options and display names for system sounds.

classes.name: VoiceWakeChimePlayer
classes.description: A singleton actor responsible for playing voice wake chimes, with logging and handling of different sound types.

methods.name: systemName
methods.description: Returns the system name if the chime is a system type.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly label for the chime.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the specified chime sound with logging.

methods.name: sound
methods.description: Retrieves the NSSound object for a given chime.
